recipient_is_blacklisted.meaning: the recipient address of the cross-chain mint is blacklisted
recipient_is_blacklisted.checkpoint: before lzReceive processing of the incoming message

cross_chain_message_arrived.meaning: a cross-chain message has arrived via LayerZero to mint tokens to a user on the Spoke chain
cross_chain_message_arrived.checkpoint: before lzReceive processing of the incoming message

bridge_blocked_for_other_users.meaning: the entire Hub-to-Spoke cross-chain bridge is blocked so no other users can bridge tokens or receive unstaked funds
bridge_blocked_for_other_users.checkpoint: after the blacklisted-recipient message fails to succeed

claims.scope: LayerZero cross-chain message delivery minting iTryTokenOFT tokens on the Spoke chain (MegaETH)

preconditions.text: The recipient address of the cross-chain mint is blacklisted.; A cross-chain message arrives via LayerZero to mint tokens to a user on the Spoke chain.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: A blacklisted recipient of a bridge mint should not cause the LayerZero message execution to revert in a way that blocks processing of subsequent higher-nonce messages for other users.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The entire Hub-to-Spoke cross-chain bridge is blocked so no other users can bridge tokens or receive unstaked funds.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The blacklisted-recipient message is one of the ordered LayerZero messages whose failure would precede subsequent higher-nonce messages for other users.
The bridge blockage is assessed at the point after the blacklisted-recipient message fails, without admin un-blacklisting remediation.

limitations: The lzReceive revert (lzreceive_reverts) and nonce-ordering mechanism (channel_permanently_blocked) are intermediate mechanisms, not the selected impact, and are not formalized here.
The bridge-blockage observable is represented as a report-grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric definition of blockage.
Other impacts (griefing_sabotage, channel_permanently_blocked, lzreceive_reverts) are handled in separate claim-generation passes and are not covered by this plan.
